title: Log Atlas
summary: Keep a trace corpus inside Rust/WASM, run regex queries and compact aggregations locally, then explore the result as a dense waterfall without uploading data.
question: Can Vooya keep a long-lived trace model behind a typed component boundary while Vue sends coarse query controls instead of shuttling every row through JavaScript?
